description: Permanently deletes a presentation and ends its live session if one is running. Results of past sessions stay readable with `sparka_results_get` by `session_id` until their retention ends. Decks using this `presentation_id` stop working. This is also how an ID that was shared too widely is retired (IDs are never rotated: delete, then save the questions again to get a new ID and update the deck). Confirm with the user before calling.
name: sparka_presentation_delete
title: Delete a presentation
